spatial_reference: left/center/right refer only to the fixed world-coordinate WA-03 dining placement zones, not camera-image directions or initial coffee positions.
high_level_instruction: Start at the coffee machine with three identical prepared coffees. Add one sugar cube to any one coffee, carry all three coffees to the dining counter, and identify the coffee you sugared.

add_sugar.label: add one sugar cube to a coffee cup

place_first.label: carry one coffee cup to the dining counter

place_second.label: carry another coffee cup to the dining counter

place_third.label: carry the remaining coffee cup to the dining counter

select_left.label: pick up the coffee cup in the left dining placement zone

select_center.label: pick up the coffee cup in the center dining placement zone

select_right.label: pick up the coffee cup in the right dining placement zone
